news.title: Tech Earnings Are the Market’s Biggest Story This Week: Here’s Why Microsoft, Amazon, Intel, SanDisk, and Alphabet Will Drive the Stock Market’s Next Move
news.summary: This could be the most important week of 2026 for AI stocks. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL), Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), and SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) are preparing to report earnings, and the results could determine where the technology sector heads next. In this video, Eric Bleeker, CFA, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., previews the biggest earnings announcements and explains what investors should watch as concerns about artificial intelligence spending continue to pressure technology stocks. After sharp declines across AI infrastructure companies, Wall Street is increasingly questioning whether the hundreds of billions of dollars being invested in data centers will generate sufficient returns. Microsoft's Azure growth, Amazon Web Services' accelerating revenue, and Alphabet's expanding AI infrastructure investments will be especially important. Meanwhile, Intel, SanDisk, and SK Hynix could provide critical insight into demand for semiconductors, memory, and AI hardware. We'll break down earnings expectations, the most important numbers to watch, and why this week's results could either reignite enthusiasm for AI stocks or accelerate the selloff.
news.title_zh: 科技財報是本週市場最大焦點：Microsoft、Amazon、Intel、SanDisk 和 Alphabet 將主導股市下一步走向的原因
news.summary_zh: 這可能是 2026 對 AI 股票最重要的一週。Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT)、Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN)、Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL)、Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) 和 SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) 正準備發布財報，結果可能決定科技板塊下一步走向。在這段影片中，CFA 持有者 Eric Bleeker，24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長，預覽最大財報公告並解釋投資人應關注什麼，因對人工智慧支出的擔憂持續施壓科技股。AI 基礎設施公司普遍大幅下跌後，華爾街越來越質疑投入數千億美元於資料中心是否能產生足夠回報。Microsoft Azure 成長、Amazon Web Services 加速營收、Alphabet 擴大 AI 基礎設施投資將特別重要。同時，Intel、SanDisk 和 SK Hynix 可能提供半導體、記憶體和 AI 硬體需求的關鍵洞察。我們將分析財報預期、最重要的觀察數字，以及本週結果為何可能重燃 AI 股熱情或加速拋售。

news.title: Anthropic’s IPO Will “Suck a Massive Amount of Money” From AI Stocks, Cramer Warns
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMeta Platforms launched $35 billion of stock offerings on Monday and plans a separate $60 billion program in 2027, on the same day Anthropic reportedly planned to file publicly for its IPO. Jim Cramer warns that Anthropic’s listing will pull money away from the rest of the AI group, a group that includes Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet.
news.title_zh: Cramer 警告：Anthropic IPO 將從 AI 股票「吸走大量資金」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Meta Platforms 週一推出 $35 billion 股票發行，並計劃在 2027 另行推出 $60 billion 計劃，同一天 Anthropic 據報計劃公開申請 IPO。Jim Cramer 警告 Anthropic 掛牌將從其他 AI 群組股票抽走資金，該群組包含 Nvidia、Microsoft、Amazon 和 Alphabet。

news.title: Nvidia Is Sold Out: Jensen “Can’t Give You Chips for 2028,” Says Palo Alto CEO
news.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora says NVIDIA can’t supply chips for 2028, and Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon report their capital spending plans next week. NVIDIA’s growth through 2028 looks limited by how many chips it can make, so Wall Street’s revenue estimates look conservative.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora 指出 NVIDIA 無法供應 2028 的晶片，而 Microsoft、Alphabet 和 Amazon 將於下週公布其資本支出計畫。NVIDIA 至 2028 的增長受限於其可生產的晶片數量，因此華爾街的營收預估顯得保守。

news.title: Google Cloud Has “a Meaningful Shot” at Lapping Microsoft, and Nobody Is Pricing It
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGoogle Cloud revenue grew 82% to $24. 8 billion in the second quarter, against 42% growth for Microsoft’s Azure and 37% for Amazon Web Services.
news.title_zh: Google Cloud 有「有意義的機會」超越 Microsoft，但無人為此定價
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Google Cloud 營收從 82% 成長至 $24。第二季 8 billion，而 Microsoft Azure 成長 42%，Amazon Web Services 成長 37%。

news.title: Prediction: Earnings Will “Double” at Amazon, Alphabet and Meta in Five Years
news.summary: Key TakeawaysInvestor Whitney Tilson said on Bloomberg Surveillance that he looks for quality companies whose earnings will double in five years, which takes about 15% growth a year. Consensus estimates have Amazon’s and Alphabet’s normalized EPS growing about 26% and 24% a year from 2026 to 2028, well ahead of that pace.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 投資人 Whitney Tilson 在 Bloomberg Surveillance 表示，他尋找盈利將在五年內翻倍的優質公司，這需要每年約 15% 的增長。共識預估 Amazon 和 Alphabet 的經調整 EPS 從 2026 到 2028 每年分別增長約 26% 和 24%，遠超該步伐。

news.title: Tech Earnings Are the Market’s Biggest Story This Week: Here’s Why Microsoft, Amazon, Intel, SanDisk, and Alphabet Will Drive the Stock Market’s Next Move
news.summary: This could be the most important week of 2026 for AI stocks. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL), Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), and SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) are preparing to report earnings, and the results could determine where the technology sector heads next. In this video, Eric Bleeker, CFA, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., previews the biggest earnings announcements and explains what investors should watch as concerns about artificial intelligence spending continue to pressure technology stocks. After sharp declines across AI infrastructure companies, Wall Street is increasingly questioning whether the hundreds of billions of dollars being invested in data centers will generate sufficient returns. Microsoft's Azure growth, Amazon Web Services' accelerating revenue, and Alphabet's expanding AI infrastructure investments will be especially important. Meanwhile, Intel, SanDisk, and SK Hynix could provide critical insight into demand for semiconductors, memory, and AI hardware. We'll break down earnings expectations, the most important numbers to watch, and why this week's results could either reignite enthusiasm for AI stocks or accelerate the selloff.
